name: robots/avisengine__avis-engine-python-api
title: AVIS Engine car (avisengine.Car)
intro: AVIS Engine car (avisengine.Car), adapted from avisengine/avis-engine-python-api. It reads `speed` and `sensors`; sets `throttle`, `steering` and `sensor_angle`; runs `stop_motion`. `stop_motion`: stop all motion on the resource with a declared deceleration profile and report the stopping position. This capability is always cancellable=false and is exempt from rate limiting. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
